articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI support bot got social-engineered harder than a freshman at DEF CON, leading to the Obama White House Instagram getting tagged with pro-Iranian memes. When your AI is dumber than a Telegram script kiddie, maybe it's time to rethink automation.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually dropped AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like breadcrumbs for nation-states. The agency tasked with protecting America's infrastructure just handed out the skeleton keys to anyone with a browser.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI pick perfectly illustrates why Section 702's warrantless mass surveillance needs to die. When political hacks control the panopticon, everyone's privacy is fucked.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day is getting hammered in the wild with zero patches on the horizon. Cisco's response time makes geological epochs look speedy.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories in Major Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: AI agent autonomously discovered 21 zero-days in FFmpeg while Google patched a record 429 Chrome bugs. The robots are getting scary good at breaking things, which is honestly more impressive than most human pentesters.

articles.title: NSA using Clause Mythos for 'offensive cyber operations,' report claims — says 'half-a-dozen' Anthropic engineers embedded inside the agency
articles.summary: Miasma worm infected 73 Microsoft GitHub repos in a self-replicating supply chain clusterfuck. When even Microsoft can't secure their own repositories, the rest of us are truly screwed.

articles.title: Winklevoss-Backed Zcash Treasury Plunges Nearly 40% on ZEC Privacy Bug Concerns
articles.summary: NSA is reportedly using Anthropic's Claude for 'offensive cyber operations' with half-a-dozen company engineers embedded inside the agency. Nothing says 'Don't Be Evil' like weaponizing AI for state-sponsored hacking.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Massive ZCash Exploit Found by Claude, Extent Unknown
articles.summary: AI-assisted researcher discovered a catastrophic Zcash exploit hiding in zero-knowledge proof circuits for four years. Privacy coins aren't so private when the math is fundamentally broken.

articles.title: No data breach: IIT Roorkee rubbishes claims of privacy violation affecting JEE Advanced 2026 students
articles.summary: Five Eyes warns that Chinese spies are sliding into LinkedIn DMs posing as recruiters to honeypot government and military personnel. The oldest trick in the book works because humans are still the weakest link.

articles.title: Using LLMs to secure source code | Claude
articles.summary: Cisco SD-WAN Manager has another root-level vulnerability with no patch or workaround available. Cisco's security track record makes Swiss cheese look impenetrable.
